# Changes

Source: [JuliusBrussee/caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), compared with upstream commit `e2c09c9` (2026-07-03), when the repository used MIT; Apache-2.0 applies from 3.0.0. `README.md` is identical to that commit. `SKILL.md` differs by one line (line 15): it is always on from the first message of every session.

Line 48 of `caveman/README.md` links to `../../README.md`, the top-level README of the upstream repository, which is not included here. The link is preserved as upstream wrote it; that README lives at https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman.
